Evidence/VIS-PROVIDER-TIME
Evidence record

Provider status over time: the 2026 roster and dated decisions

What does this evidence establish?

The official 2026 exchange and remittance roster of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) lists 98 exchange companies, 225 individual exchange establishments and 106 remittance agents. Selected decisions of the CBY-Aden Governor dated January to September 2026 suspend or withdraw the licences of named entities or close their premises; they are kept separate from the roster and matched to it entity by entity, because the roster's issue date is not stated. Listing or licensing is not evidence of current operation.

What does it measure?

The 2026 exchange and remittance roster of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden), counted by class, alongside selected CBY-Aden decisions of 2026 that change the licence status of named entities.

Who or what does it apply to?

Provider classes and named entities as defined by the cited authority sources; annual roster inclusion does not establish current operation.

When was it measured or observed?

The official 2026 roster (issue date not stated) and decisions dated January to September 2026.

How current is it?

The roster is the official 2026 roster, whose issue date is not stated; the latest decision covered is Decision No. 18 of 24 September 2026. A decision changes the status only of the entities it names; it does not redefine the whole roster or show that entities it does not name are operating.

What this evidence does not establish

The 2026 roster can be counted by class, but the counts are not a verified census of providers operating now. The 2026 decisions are matched to named entities one by one, without assuming whether the roster already reflects them, because the roster does not state its issue date; the complete named set of wallet and payment-service providers is not established.
